scope: Measure the current calibrated Qwen IQ2_XS/Q2_0 two-GPU MTP path on B550 with explicit 2 MiB hugetlb backing versus STRATA_NO_LARGEPAGES, then release the experimental page pool. No huge-page setting was persisted.

environment.artifact: /home/kearm/strata-scratch/qwen-iq2xs-calibrated/pack-split plus the pinned split GGUF and Q2_0 MTP runtime
environment.explicit_pool: 16512 x 2 MiB pages, runtime sysctl only

arms: control: STRATA_NO_LARGEPAGES=1, explicitly using 4 KiB pages
protocol.interleaving: hugetlb, control, hugetlb, control server starts
protocol.requests_per_arm: 5 total; the cold first request was discarded, leaving 8 warm samples per arm across two rounds
protocol.request: The saved 25-token binary-search prompt, max_tokens 128, temperature 0, reasoning_effort none
protocol.configuration: two-GPU layer-split auto, expert-cache auto, prefill auto, spec 4, Q2_0 MTP max-t 4, max-context 2048, KV int8, direct PLE I/O, no pipeline-windows override
protocol.resident_embedding_services: both unrelated sindexer CUDA replicas stayed resident

backing_confirmed.hugetlb: expert arena: cudaHostRegister PORTABLE ok; hugetlb 2 MB pages
backing_confirmed.control: expert arena: cudaHostRegister PORTABLE ok; large pages skipped (STRATA_NO_LARGEPAGES); using 4 KB pages

warm_decode_tok_s.interpretation: No hugetlb decode win on this fully resident workload; the tiny observed difference favors control by about 0.16 percent.

warm_prompt_tok_s.interpretation: A negligible approximately 0.5 percent hugetlb prompt-rate difference.

expert_load_seconds.interpretation: Hugetlb reduced this 32.23 GiB expert-load phase by a median 7.5 seconds in alternating rounds.

decision: Do not persist vm.nr_hugepages for this workload. Hugetlb improves load time but not warm inference, while a persistent 16512-page pool removes about 32 GiB from general memory. Revisit only for a startup-sensitive service or a measured host-expert/cache-miss-heavy workload.

checks.name: hugetlb-real-engine
checks.command: start the saved two-GPU Strata server and require the hugetlb 2 MB pages startup line

checks.name: matched-openai-workload
checks.command: five localhost OpenAI chat requests per round for two interleaved rounds per arm

checks.name: four-kb-control
checks.command: repeat with STRATA_NO_LARGEPAGES=1 and require the using 4 KB pages startup line

checks.name: restore-host
checks.command: stop Strata, set vm.nr_hugepages=0, and verify services, GPU memory, driver, and both P2P matrices

non_claims: This short, fully resident warm workload does not measure long-context, multi-client, batch, memory-pressure, or host-expert cache-miss behavior.
Load-time observations use the server's one-second progress output and are directional, not a high-resolution storage benchmark.
No persistent host, boot, or Strata configuration was changed; the experimental page pool was released.
The identical response-content hash does not prove broad generation quality, only identical content for this exact prompt and settings.
The unrelated sindexer embedding replicas remained resident, matching the prior B550 baseline conditions but adding fixed GPU memory occupancy.
